strategy: The robot navigates toward its goal by prioritizing safe movement in the direction of the goal, avoiding obstacles, and stopping when no safe path exists.

decisions.condition: goal_ahead is true and front_blocked is false
decisions.reason: The goal is directly ahead and the front path is unblocked, allowing the robot to move toward the goal.

decisions.condition: goal_on_left is true and left_blocked is false
decisions.reason: The goal is on the left and the left path is unblocked, allowing the robot to move toward the goal.

decisions.condition: goal_on_right is true and right_blocked is false
decisions.reason: The goal is on the right and the right path is unblocked, allowing the robot to move toward the goal.

decisions.condition: front_blocked is true and left_blocked is true and right_blocked is true
decisions.reason: All directions are blocked, and the robot must stop to avoid obstacles and ensure safe navigation.

stop_condition: The robot must stop when all directions (front, left, right) are blocked to ensure safe navigation and avoid obstacles.
